column7: The fips140=only startup self-test refusal (encryption.BootFIPSSelfTest, from FIPS-TAILS-1) never ran in CI because no job sets GODEBUG=fips140=only. The unexported fipsSelfTestEnforced seam now lets the default-mode test force enforcement with one path stubbed to panic: BootFIPSSelfTest returns the *FIPSSelfTestError naming that path, later paths do not run, and the text matches the docs/operator/startup-refusals.md entry. FIPS-TAILS-2 item 6.
